caption: Example signals only (ex: …). Illustrative design telemetry, not live bank KPIs. Trip rules are the contract this demo enforces.

breakers.name: Document Intelligence
breakers.trip: Error rate >5% or p95 >30s over 5 min
breakers.degrade: Pause extract; queue files; page ops

breakers.name: Azure OpenAI summarize
breakers.degrade: Stop the LLM node; HITL packet without narrative

breakers.name: Extract confidence
breakers.trip: Share of fields below 0.90 exceeds 25% of the pack
breakers.degrade: Force HITL; widen the eval sample

breakers.name: Analyst queue
breakers.trip: Open HITL above SLA (50 cases or >4h p50)
breakers.degrade: Throttle intake; alert the Risk Ops lead. Never approve

breakers.name: Case / GRC write
breakers.trip: Write fail >2% or dead-letter queue >0 for 10 min
breakers.degrade: Freeze completions; retry the dead-letter queue. Never approve

breakers.name: Network egress
breakers.degrade: Kill the run; open a security incident bridge
